blocks.html:
Mercedes Partial Van Wrap

Vinyl Wrap Toronto has been wrapping Cool Check’s vehicles for the last 7 years. The latest one arrived straight from the Mercedes dealership. Just the way we like our vans, clean and with no issues. This Mercedes Metris van is 1 of 2 new vehicle additions to their growing fleet. We have the pleasure of doing a partial van wrap for both again. Here are some of the previous vehicles Vinyl Wrap Toronto has wrapped for Cool Check. The logo designs have changed over the years as you can see by the pictures. Our graphics team and installation crew worked together to ensure the graphics are applied correctly.
Every time any vinyl is applied, we send the client proof for them to approve. We then use this proof to make sure the graphics are correct before we let the client pick it up. We have also done branding for Cool Check on their workwear as well as stationary.

Visit us in-store to see more of our branded items and corporate apparel. We can use the same logo that we apply to the vehicles to brand any item you wish. Whether it is with vinyl or printed, we can brand it with your company logo. If you would like to find out more about the vinyl we use, Click Here.
